conviction_note: CYPH is a Zcash treasury vehicle whose Q3 print is a mark-to-market of ~323k ZEC that the market can already compute (ZEC $400 at 30 Jun to ~$1,417 at 30 Sep, now ~$944); the window's move will be set mostly by the ZEC price over the weekend and Monday, which nobody can see, so abs_move is large (14, the name's median print reaction against 174% realised vol) and p_up sits near 50 (52) on a slight lean from a headline GAAP profit of roughly $300m+ against a $0.02 adjusted-EPS consensus, an oversold tape after -33% in five days, and new ATM/holdings disclosure. The findings sum (+0.8) and the scaled number (+0.56) agree in sign and size; neither is a call.
bar: Single source: Benzinga earnings-forecasts page shows Q3 2026 consensus non-GAAP EPS $0.02 and revenue $10.6M (mining revenue) (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/CYPH/earnings-forecasts, via search snippet; the page itself returned 403). No company guidance. Bar is single-sourced, so every finding is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct refers to revenue: my own extrapolation of 3,023 ZEC mined 18-31 Aug (8-K 2026-09-22) at CoinGecko prices gives ~$10.5m if September output held the August daily rate; a network-hashrate response to ZEC tripling would cut September output, hence -5%. GAAP EPS will be a very large positive on the ZEC fair-value line and is not comparable with the $0.02 adjusted bar.
positioning_check: Short interest 15.4m shares, ~14.3% of shares outstanding (~108m), 1.20 days to cover, FINRA settlement 2026-10-30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/cyph/shortinterest, from the sweep row). Moderately elevated but not crowded in days-to-cover terms. Skew: skew_25d_vol_points is null in the baseline; put/call OI 1.05, ATM IV 159%, straddle 19.5% over 7 days but ATM spread 50% of mid, so the chain says only 'large move', not direction. Run-up -33.2% over 5 days, -25.1% over 20 days, -53% from 52-week high, all tracking ZEC (ZEC $1,322 on 7 Nov to ~$944 on 13 Nov, CoinGecko). Largest holder Winklevoss Treasury Investments exercised (did not sell) 4.94m pre-funded warrants on 2026-10-12 and still holds 29.8m shares plus 97.2m pre-funded warrants.

findings.finding: Q3 GAAP net income will carry a very large ZEC fair-value gain: the company marked 323,394 ZEC at $400.09 on 30 Jun 2026 (Q2 release) and CoinGecko prices ZEC at $1,417 on 30 Sep 2026, so the 'change in fair value of embedded derivative' line is roughly +$330m on a ~$130m June carrying value, against a Benzinga consensus of $0.02 adjusted EPS; headline GAAP EPS will read in dollars per share, not cents.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (12 Aug) printed $39.4m net income / $0.18 diluted on a $46.0m ZEC gain against an adjusted bar of -$0.03; the stock fell 3.24% (baseline). Q1 2026 printed a $77.2m loss on ZEC and the stock rose 15.4% (14 May). The name has not paid for the fair-value line in either direction.
findings.why_not_priced: The gain itself is fully computable from the public ZEC price and is in the price in substance; what is not priced is the headline: if the market had looked through it, a non-GAAP-vs-GAAP headline gap of this size would not matter, but retail-heavy treasury names have bought GAAP 'beats' at the open. Kept small because Q2's same-shaped beat was sold.
findings.independence: ZEC price at 30 Jun and 30 Sep from CoinGecko history API (https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/zcash/history?date=30-09-2026); shares the Q2 release with the cash/ATM finding.

findings.finding: The 30 Sep balance-sheet value is already 33% stale: ZEC has fallen from $1,417 (30 Sep) to ~$944 (13 Nov 18:40 UTC, CoinGecko), implying a quarter-to-date unrealised loss of roughly $160m on ~340k ZEC that management will be asked about on the X Spaces call; the reported NAV per share overstates today's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock tracks ZEC day to day: -47% on 5 Jun 2026 after a Zcash bug disclosure (Baselight), -33% over the last 5 sessions as ZEC fell ~29%. No print-day precedent for a stale NAV.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock is -33% in five days with ZEC. If it were not priced the stock would still sit near its October range ($2.7-$4). Filed small because the release will present a Sep-30 NAV per share that headlines may compare with a $1.93 stock, which cuts both ways.
findings.independence: Cointelegraph/cryptoticker coverage of the November ZEC drop after the NU7 upgrade (https://cryptoticker.io/en/zcash-price-falls-16-percent-to-1003-dollars/).

findings.finding: Mining revenue may fall short of the $10.6M consensus: the fleet (4.2 GSol/s, ~18% of network at purchase) mined 3,023.13 ZEC from 18-31 Aug (~216 ZEC/day); holding that rate through September at CoinGecko prices gives ~$10.5m for Q3, i.e. the bar assumes no loss of network share, while ZEC rising from ~$510 to ~$1,400 between 18 Aug and 30 Sep would normally draw competing hashrate and cut CYPH's daily output.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First quarter with mining revenue; no history. The stock trades on ZEC NAV, not on revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is a single aggregator estimate that looks like the same straight-line extrapolation; if the market had priced hashrate dilution the consensus would sit below the straight-line figure. Inference, not a company number: I did not find a network-hashrate series for September, so this is a proxy and sized small.
findings.independence: Mining economics in the 18 Aug launch release (43,800 ZEC/month to all miners; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1509745/000110465926098120/tm2623453d1_ex99-1.htm); consensus from Benzinga snippet. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: The print will disclose how much the company raised in Q3/Q4 on its $200m Cantor ATM (it sold ~13.7m shares for $13.4m at ~$0.98 in Q2, and the stock then ran to a 52-week high near $4.12) and whether in-the-money October 2025 common warrants (71.99-75.99m at $0.5335, equity-classified, per the Q2 10-Q) were exercised for cash; issuance at a premium to NAV raises ZEC per share, and cash raised but unspent now meets ZEC at $944 rather than $1,400.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print-day precedent. Prior ZEC purchase announcements were bought (Stocktwits: 'Cypherpunk shares rise after buying more Zcash', Dec 2025).
findings.why_not_priced: No 8-K, 424B or holdings update has been filed since 18 Aug, so share count, cash and ZEC count after the September rally are unknown to the market; if it were priced there would be a holdings or ATM update in the record. What the money buys: ZEC accumulation toward the stated 5% target (a premium-to-NAV issuance is accretive per share), so signed small positive; if it bought ZEC near $1,400 the cost basis disclosure reads badly, hence the wide band.
findings.independence: Phemex summary of Q2 ATM use (https://phemex.com/academy/cypherpunk-technologies-cyph-zcash-holdings); warrant terms also in the Leap PIPE closing release (https://investors.leaptx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/leap-therapeutics-announces-closing-5888-million-private). Shares the Q2 10-Q/release with finding 1.

findings.finding: Leap Therapeutics has an open strategic process to fund or partner sirexatamab (Fast Track May 2026; FDA-aligned ~270-patient Phase 3 in DKK1-high 2L mCRC; DKK1-high Phase 2 OS HR 0.42), with no timetable; any partnering or spin financing announced with the print would be an unmodelled option value on a name valued on ZEC alone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pipeline news has not moved the stock since the treasury pivot; the Aug 12 DeFianCe publication came with the Q2 print, which fell 3.24%.
findings.why_not_priced: Market cap is valued against ZEC holdings; no sell-side value for the pipeline appears in the record. If it were priced, there would be a premium to NAV attributed to Leap in coverage. No sign the process concludes now, so small.
findings.independence: Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1509745/000110465926094445/tm2622925d1_ex99-1.htm) states the strategic process; same company source.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: short interest 15.4m shares (~14.3% of shares outstanding, 1.2 days to cover, FINRA 30 Oct) after a 33% five-day fall that matches ZEC's ~29% drop, with the largest holder (Winklevoss Treasury Investments) converting pre-funded warrants rather than selling (Form 4, exercise 12 Oct); a ZEC bounce or a positive headline meets a meaningful short base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints after drawdowns: +12.6% (16 Mar 2026) and +15.4% (14 May 2026) followed weak ZEC tapes; -3.2% (12 Aug) followed a flat one (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public, but at 1.2 days to cover it is not a crowded short; the size is small because the squeeze needs ZEC to cooperate. If the market were positioned for a bounce, the -33% week would have shown a reversal day.
findings.independence: WTI Form 4 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1509745/000209259626000004/form4-10142026_081048.xml) shows the largest holder accumulating, not selling.

outside_window.finding: The August 17 registration-rights amendment makes all of WTI's common and warrant shares (29.8m common plus 97.2m pre-funded) registrable; a resale registration would be an overhang, but none is filed and no date is set.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR filing list since June 2026: no 8-K holdings update, ZEC purchase or ATM 424B after 18 Aug; 8-K of 2 Sep is Nasdaq bid-price compliance regained; 8-K of 22 Sep is a director appointment plus first mining output
CYPH-specific news for 11-13 Nov 2026: none found; the week's fall is attributed to ZEC (NU7 sell-the-news, crypto deleveraging)
Option skew: baseline 25d skew null; chain too wide (50% ATM spread) for a directional read
Zcash network hashrate series for September 2026: not found, so the mining-share erosion is an inference

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and an unusable event-implied move; the run-up (-33% 5d) is ZEC-driven and my slight positive lean (oversold, headline GAAP profit, short base) cuts mildly against the tape's momentum, so p_up stays at 52 rather than higher.
